entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I'm calling about a jersey I bought a while ago. I... I really hope you can help me. I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not faulty, I guess. I just finally got around to properly trying it on for a ride and it's the wrong size. It's just way too tight, and I feel awful about it. I feel so foolish for waiting.
I understand. Let me get your order details and I'll see what we can do. Can I have your name and order number, please?

Of course. The name is Maria Garcia, and the order number is VF-88209. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I... I was really counting on getting this money back. Things are a bit tight right now.

Thank you, Maria. I appreciate you being a VeloFit customer. Let me pull up your account. Okay, I see the order for the ProFit Jersey, delivered about 60 days ago. I just need to double-check our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I'm really hoping there's something you can do.

Alright Maria, I've checked. Good news. The item is still within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to set up an exchange for the correct size?
Oh, really? A full refund is possible? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. A refund would be perfect.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get that sorted out for you. I've just sent a prepaid return label and instructions to the email on your account. Once we receive the jersey, the refund will be issued back to your original payment method.
That's wonderful. You have no idea what a help that is. Thank you again.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
